spans.s: Śuci^1, a month. § 213 (Jatugṛhap.): I, 151, 5883 (ŚuciŚukrāgame yathā; Jyeshṭhāshāḍayoḥ saṅgame, Nīl.).--§ 294 (Dyūtāp.): II, 47, 1685 (Śuci-Śukrāgame kāle…iva; Jyeshṭhāshāḍau tayoḥ saṅgame grīshmarttau, Nīl.).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 79, †4072 (yathograraśmiḥ Śuci-Śukraṃadhyagaḥ sukhaṃ vivasvān harate jalaughān; Ashāḍajyeshṭhayor madhyagataḥ, Nīl.), †4075 (Śuci-Śukramadhyago yathaiva sūryaḥ).
Śuci^2, a ṛshi. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 325 (in the palace of Yama).
Śuci^3, name of a caravan leader. § 347 (Nalopākhyāsap.): III, 64, 2526 (met the wandering Damayantī, who then followed the caravan).
Śuci^4, a fire. § 493 (Āṅgirasa): III, 221, 14200, 14202 (among the fires in honour of which ashṭākapāla rites are to be performed for the sake of expiation at the time of the agnihotra).
Śuci^5 = Sūrya: III, 148.
Śuci^6 = Skanda: III, 14631.
Śuci^7 = Kṛshṇa: XII, 1605.
Śuci^8, a son of Vicvāmitra. § 721b (Viśvāmitrop.): XIII, 4, 253.
Śuci^9 = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Śuci^10, a son of Bhṛgu. § 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4145 (the third of Bhṛgu's seven sons).
Śuci^11 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
sūcī (“needle”), name of a vyūha: VII, 2674, 3110 (śº, C.), 3111 (do.), 3114 (do.).
Śuciśravas = Kṛshṇa: XII, 1505, 13250 (etymology).
Śucisravas = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Śucikā, an Apsaras. § 191 (Arjuna): I, 123, 4818 (among the Apsarases who danced at the birth of Arjuna).
Śucipada = Kṛshṇa: XII, 1605.
Śucishmitā, an Apsaras. § 269 (Vaiśravaṇasabhāv.): II, 10, 392 (in the palace of Kubera).
Śucivrata, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 230 (in Sañjaya's enumeration of kings who have died).
Sucakra, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2561.
Sucandra^1, an Asura. § 94 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2539 (son of Siṃhikā).
Sucandra^2, a Devagandharva. § 102 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2555 (tenth son of Prādhā).--§ 191 (Arjuna): I, 123, 4814 (present at the birth of Arjuna).
Sucāru^1, son of Kṛshṇa and Rakmiṇī. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 14, 621.
Sucāru^2, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra(?). § 583 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 79, 3470/71 (only B.).
Sucetas, a brahman, son of Gṛtsamada. § 736b (Vītahavyap.): XIII, 30, 2000 (Gṛtsamadasya putraḥ, in the second halfśloka the name is read Sutejas).
sūcīmukha (“pointed as a needle”), name of a vyūha: VI, 699, 3395; XII, 3729 (anīkaṃ).
Sūcīroman = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Sucitra^1, a serpent. § 66 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2159 (of Dhṛtarāshṭra's race).
Sucitra^2, one or more kings. § 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6990 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 1771 (ºś Citravarmā ca pitāputrau, slain by Droṇa).
Sucitra^3, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra(?). § 583 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 79, 3470/71 (only B.).
Sūcīvaktra, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2574.
